# ChatGPT discovery fixtures

These fixtures are tracked, synthetic or manually redacted traces for the V1 discovery contract. Keep only route identities replaced with placeholders, schema field names, turn counts, typed message IDs, and lifecycle events. Never add conversation text, cookies, authorization values, tokens, raw headers, or unredacted network captures.

The real probe record belongs in the ignored `output/chatgpt-discovery/` directory. A fixture must include its source scenario and redaction note in the test that consumes it.
